{{Quote|We're staying, commander.|Rebel trooper to Commander [[Jun Sato]], during their last moments|<ref name="Zero Hour" />}}
A '''Rebel trooper''' served on [[Phoenix Cell]]'s [[flagship]], the ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'', during the [[Battle of Atollon]]. After the order given by [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] to evacuate the ship, the trooper and his partner decided to stay with their commander. He died after the ship rammed into [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine|Konstantine's]] [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Zero Hour" />
